'''Verdant Swamp''' was a swamp located on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] near to the [[Imperial Guard Academy]]. During the [[Revanite crisis]] the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] established an [[Republic Forward Camp]] in the area.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Verdant Swamp appears as an area on Yavin in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
